title: After Siang dam protests, Amit Shah says Centre will hold ‘constructive’ talks in Arunachal

ai.summary: Union Home Minister Amit Shah said the Centre will hold constructive talks with stakeholders about the Siang dam project after protests turned violent in Arunachal Pradesh.

facts.claim: Amit Shah said the Centre will hold constructive talks with stakeholders about the Siang dam project
facts.quote: Union Home Minister Amit Shah on Saturday said that “positive and constructive” discussions will be held with stakeholders about the project.

facts.claim: Protests turned violent in Arunachal Pradesh
facts.quote: On October 23, protesters vandalised and set fire to an office of the National Hydroelectric Power Corporation and a police station in Pasighat after security personnel fired tear gas during the agitation.

ai.background_note: The Siang dam project, proposed in 2017 by NITI Aayog, is the country's largest dam if completed and has faced opposition from local communities in Arunachal Pradesh.
